{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Seasonedmalelings.png|thumb|250px|Seasoned malelings serving as [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Zalem/Legends|Zalem's]] bodyguards]]
{{Quote|It is not appropriate for malelings to converse amongst themselves, you must appreciate that you're a lesser species. You must be seasoned.|[[Vonya]] to [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]|<ref name="RTIE">[[Star Wars (1998) 23|''Star Wars'' (1998) 23]]</ref>}}
'''Maleling''' was a slang term the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] used to describe [[Gender/Legends|male]] individuals from a patronizing standpoint. On the [[Witch/Legends|witches]]' [[Planet/Legends|planet]], matriarchy was taken to an extreme, and male individuals were relegated to the status of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and [[Reproduction/Legends|breeding]] stock.

==Use of the term==
{{Quote|Am I so ugly that you would rather be captured by the Nightsisters? Would you rather spawn with one of them and watch your daughters master their spells?|[[Teneniel Djo]] to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="copl">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>}}
In the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]]' culture, males were only used as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] or [[Reproduction/Legends|mating]] partners, whence their other name of "breeder". The breeders usually were healthy [[Human/Legends|Humans]] (or [[Near-Human]]s), while [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] were most often turned into mere "labor units". Malelings were usually contained behind [[proximity shield]]s. Breeders were generally killed after mating,<ref name="RTIE" /> though it was not always the case.<ref name="copl" />

The more benevolent [[Witches of Dathomir]] would only refer to men in non-derogatory yet pragmatic terms such as "males" or "mates". They still considered them their servants and viewed them as property. For example, if a witch from a rival clan stole a male slave to take as a husband, it was considered unseemly for the man's initial owner to try and recover him. Male servants, however, could win their freedom by saving the life of a clan sister. "[[Jai (Dathomir)|Male witches]]" or "male spellcasters" were considered a great prize.<ref name="copl" />

==History==
{{Quote|Perhaps you should be one of my&hellip; personal bodyguards&hellip;Quin?''"<br />"''Well, er&hellip;''"<br />"''Missed your chance.|Zalem and Quinlan Vos|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 24">[[Star Wars (1998) 24|''Star Wars'' (1998) 24]]</ref>}}
In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], a [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]], was captured by a group of Nightsisters. Though the Sisters initially considered him "chain-gang material" only, some of the witches like [[Yongti]] expressed interest in mating with him. The leader of the Nightsisters, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Zalem/Legends|Zalem]] herself, offered Vos to become one of her personal [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]]&mdash;a position that seemed to imply carnal pleasures. As he seemed reluctant, Zalem canceled her offer and made him a [[Lizard Keeper]] instead.<ref name="RTIE" />

After the defeat of Queen Zalem, the [[Shaman of the Nightsisters]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] reunited the covens under her banner, and she decided to restrict the use of males to the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabraks]] known as the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]].<ref name="BoSSotDS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

[[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the young [[Teneniel Djo]] captured [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Isolder]] of [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. She intended to bear Skywalker's children as she had sensed his exceptional connection with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="copl" />
